title: Imports
description: Track uploaded files and job status. Applied imports can be rolled back within 24 hours when no conflicting changes exist.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view import jobs.
empty_description: Start a new job from the Import button on the Users or Roles list page.
wizard_description: Upload your file, map columns, preview the result, and confirm.
format_hint: Make sure the format matches your file extension.
file_hint: Supported formats: Excel (.xlsx), CSV, TSV, and JSON.
mapping_hint: Pick the source column for each target field. Unmapped columns are ignored.
mapping_auto_hint: Column names are matched to target fields using fuzzy similarity.
mapping_none: No automatic matches found. Map columns manually.
mapping_duplicate: The same column cannot be assigned to multiple fields.
defaults_hint: Provide defaults for required fields that are not present in the file.
defaults_required: {{count}} required field(s) still need a default value.
preview_hint: Nothing is written to the database in this step — validation only.
confirm_hint: After confirmation the job is queued and rows are applied.
detail.title: Import detail
detail.description: Uploaded file, column mapping, preview result, and job status.
detail.not_found: Import job not found or you do not have access.
rollback_hint: Within 24 hours you can revert an applied import if records were not changed afterward.
done_message: The import is being applied in the background. Track progress on the Imports page and in notifications.
toast.sample_failed: Could not download the sample file.
toast.upload_failed: Upload failed. Check the format and file size.
